thread.document:
For Special Participation A, I used Mistral AI's Le Chat on the written portion of HW5. Overall, it performed averagely - mostly arriving at correct answers in one shot, but in a couple of cases requiring further prompting to correct mistakes. I found some indication of a lack of ability to refer to chat history in it's responses.

Here is the link to my chat: https://chat.mistral.ai/chat/9c9c7fc7-7985-45a9-b7cd-df337fec5d26
